ids: D1/D2/D3 and C1–C10; Proto23/source comparison; passive correction
reviews.classification: Full historical idea/research note; accepted later direction and scoped mechanisms separated
reviews.disposition:
F1. Full note review includes the initial optional-hunger recommendations, Proto23 comparison, later accepted food direction and explicit passive-progression correction. The accepted ordinary baseline is comfortable unfed play with useful food benefits and no hunger death; Famine can gain positive eligible passive progress. The active-exertion-only suggestion was already withdrawn. The earlier paragraph calling the follow-up tentative and the old milestone sentence are historical, not current authority. An eight-hour fullness drain/80–100% native efficiency observation and Proto23's20% effectiveness/52% XP calculation are dated source evidence, not freshly verified current balances.

F2. Preserve the distinction between identical bonus/penalty arithmetic and the actual unfed experience: affordability, duration, repeat effort, assumed enemy/income baseline and real useful meal effects decide pressure. Do not add an overlapping fullness bonus or a penalty whose sole purpose is to give Famine something to cancel. Positive fractions, eligible time segmentation and actual condition continuity matter; toggles, render or login do not award new time. Actual auto-eating must respect selected stock/training policy rather than consume valuable ingredients or erase underfed training by implication. Supported nutrition-free bodies need no invented substitute starvation.

F3. C6's unlimited-eating restriction is a proposed stacking/capacity policy, not a universal ban on genuine cumulative nutrition, absorption or strong food faculties under AD22/AD38. Thirst, spoilage, disease, temperature and equipment wear retain separate actual mechanisms and scope. Use current clock/continuation owners, AD36/AD43 and AD42 optional review for selected work; this report does not authorize a new hunger experiment, settings migration or runtime change. Under AD32 exact rates and broader need systems remain proposals.

ids: crossing premise; two approaches; outcome/aftermath/engine contracts; creative question
reviews.classification: Full historical idea/research note; accepted later direction and scoped mechanisms separated
reviews.disposition:
F1. Full review retains the broken-crossing rescue palette: securing the route versus extracting the traveler, actual knowledge/kit/strength/time, graded recovery and a later scene that reads the recorded result. Bought preparation can substitute for personal craft mastery. Comparable effort is a proposed prototype comparison, not mandatory equalization of genuinely superior powers under AD22/AD38. A real deadline scheduler is needed only where a selected event has an actual deadline; saving the premise does not create one.

F2. Commit must revalidate the quoted means and preserve actual inputs/outcome/history across pending and settled saves. Fixed event identity/draws prevent replaying one resolution as new rewards, while a genuine selected time/fate mechanic can define a different replay policy. Prior supply commitment, later injury and route repair are separate effects. The first occurrence waiting for the player is local proposed behavior, not a claim about all events or current global absence policy.

F3. The Oct1 question about selecting the first playable event is historical; current campaign/task owners govern build order. It does not insert a rescue event ahead of Klein or Harry, demand a new approval for routine already-authorized prototype choices, or silently select permanent peer death. AD42 makes human review optional; AD36/AD43 govern selected proof. Under AD32 this premise and severity remain proposals, with no new runtime, save namespace or source claim established here.

ids: five families; trope directions; subtle rules; selection test; Oct3 bookshelf refinement
reviews.classification: Full historical idea/research note; accepted later direction and scoped mechanisms separated
reviews.disposition:
F1. Full review preserves the distinction between a modifier and a power that changes strategy, acquisition, persistence, constraints, goals or controlled actors. The five families are temporal retention, production/private space, profession access, invested/reclaimable capacity and distributed agency. Their linked chapter/prologue/synopsis evidence retains its original narrow scope: a publisher premise is not detailed replication law, one reclaimable helper is not universal refund, and an unresolved bottle mechanism remains a dated source gap. No links or primary chapters were freshly fetched in this reconciliation.

F2. Keep activation/ownership, acquisition, operation, growth, recovery, source compatibility, stacking and retention explicit at the selected consumer. A copied method, produced item, grown material and replaced body affect different owners. A genuinely strong advantage stays strong; enemy scaling and forced scarcity do not automatically cancel it. One bounded prototype does not set permanent fictional weakness. Origin/world axes can share adapters without authoring every Cartesian combination or treating all powerful abilities as a stat modifier.

F3. Same-chapter and differing-circumstance comparisons are proposed ways to test a claim, not a new two-origin gate on every first consumer. AD51 permits designing a shared seam from known mechanisms, with different-world validation qualifying reuse. The Oct3 claim that the one-prestige first milestone remains authoritative is superseded; current campaign and carryover owners govern. The original ring/vessel pair and later network experiment are not a selected roster or current runtime queue. Under AD32 the paths remain useful proposals; no acquisition, source expansion, migration, runtime or browser proof follows from saving them.

ids: five lane/table owners; source/biology steering; synthesis gate; genre follow-up
reviews.classification: Full historical idea/research note; accepted later direction and scoped mechanisms separated
reviews.disposition:
F1. Full review covers all five historical dossier/chat assignments, source/biology steering, synthesis boundaries and the later single-chat genre sweep. The tables record who owned research at that time; they do not reserve current shared paths, spawn readers or authorize sending messages. Calibre/EPUB presence did not prove preference, complete reading or edition authority. Preserve the separation between genre convention, source rule, protagonist exception and original mechanic, with critical recognition/popularity/awards separately attributed.

F2. Retain useful compact causal comparisons and the split between fictional physiology and real biological claims. The old at-most-three source-gap recommendation is prioritization for that historical report, not a standing acquisition command or permission to buy/read every missing source. Use current library coverage and source-tool owners only when a selected consumer actually needs qualification. A catalogue cannot prove whole-genre completeness, and synthesis is not implementation.

F3. The five-stage research proposal and Jade Hollow reset references preserve provenance rather than current build order or a permanent rejected design. Current Klein/LOTM and Harry developer-route owners govern. No historical chat assignment or follow-up sweep reopens a lane, adopts its mechanics or makes a whole playable chapter an extra gate for every documentation edit. Under AD32 proposals retain their status; AD36/AD43 govern actual selected implementation. Linked dossier bodies, primary books, library state and current runtime were not reverified by this read.
